name: JorRaptor
noteEs: JorRaptor cubre RPGs y open-world games con foco en news, tips & tricks y patch breakdowns. Para Cyberpunk 2077 es punto de entrada útil: videos cortos (8-15min) que sintetizan info de cada patch, tips para players retornando después de un patch, build overviews accesibles. Multi-game por naturaleza (Assassin's Creed, Horizon, God of War, etc.) — Cyberpunk es uno de sus pilares pero no su único foco. Mejor para players casuales que quieren signal-vs-noise rápido.
noteEn: JorRaptor covers RPGs and open-world games focused on news, tips & tricks, and patch breakdowns. For Cyberpunk 2077 he's a useful entry point: short videos (8-15min) synthesizing each patch's info, tips for returning players, accessible build overviews. Multi-game by nature (Assassin's Creed, Horizon, God of War, etc.) — Cyberpunk is one of his pillars but not his only focus. Best for casual players wanting fast signal-vs-noise.
highlightsEs: Patch breakdowns en formato corto cada vez que CDPR publica un update mayor
Tips para players retornando — qué cambió desde la última vez que jugaste
Build overviews accesibles para principiantes que no quieren leer guías largas
News round-ups del estado del juego, datamining y rumors
highlightsEn: Short-format patch breakdowns each time CDPR ships a major update
Tips for returning players — what changed since last time you played
Beginner-friendly build overviews for players who don't want long guides
News round-ups on the game's state, datamining, and rumors
